name: permission-modes-from-sdk
brief: Offer all six permission modes the Claude Agent SDK 0.3.235 declares (default, acceptEdits, plan, dontAsk, auto, bypassPermissions) for new Pods. Orcastrate's PermissionMode becomes a type-only alias of the SDK union, and every runtime list (the PodRunner allow-list, the IPC validator message, the schema-head list) is held exact over it by build-time guards, so an SDK that adds or removes a mode fails npm run typecheck. Migration 6 rebuilds pods to widen the permission_mode CHECK, carrying migration 5's ancestry columns, named FK and index; migration 3 is untouched. Main reads each Pod's supportedModels() answer and latest init model, caches the latest defined auto-mode answer app-wide and pushes it to the renderer on a new push channel; the New Pod dialog hides auto when that cached flag is false and shows it when true or nothing is cached. Danger treatment stays on bypassPermissions only. Three serial tasks: T1 database, T2 backend, T3 frontend.
